title: Make even number calculator
goal: makes a calculator with two columns of operating areas, supports addition and subtraction and gives prompts when the input is invalid.
summary: Use CSS to arrange two number input boxes and operation buttons in a row. Read the current input in JavaScript, check the value, calculate and display the result via button selection.
tasks: Arrange .number-fields and .operations into two columns in style.css, each column has the same width and is 12px apart from the left and right. The results area is placed below the two sets of controls.

completes calculate in script.js. Read two inputs, remove leading and trailing spaces, and use Number to convert them into numbers. When any item is empty or cannot be converted to a finite value, "Please enter two valid digits." is displayed.

When the Add button is clicked, the result of adding two numbers is displayed. When the subtraction button is clicked, the first number minus the second number is displayed. The results are output in #calc-result.
hint: Number will convert the empty string to the value 0. First identify empty input, then use Number.isFinite to validate the value. Subtract 3 from 8 to check the order of the subtraction operands.

example.note: The ticket booking page arranges the two ticket options into two columns of equal width. minmax(0, 1fr) allows two columns to be reduced together in a narrow window.
